policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Rwanda DGIE's current ordinary-passport schedule expressly records visa-free access for Bangladesh, Central African Republic, Côte d'Ivoire, Guinea-Bissau, Liberia, Mali and Niger. The Republic of the Congo row is classified separately from the controlling bilateral agreement.
conditions: This is limited to the named ordinary-passport rows in Rwanda DGIE's current outbound schedule; it is not inferred from EAC, AU, COMESA, bilateral or regional membership.

For CI, the destination MFA/SNEDAI pages describe a general applicant visa workflow but do not publish a Rwanda-specific override. Rwanda DGIE's passport-specific ordinary row says Visa not required, so the generic applicant route is not normalized as applying to this named visa-free passport.
Purpose, stay period, accepted document, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: Republic of the Congo free visa on arrival
policies.summary: The Republic of the Congo’s ratified Rwanda agreement gives holders of an ordinary passport issued by either Party a free visa at entry to the other Party, valid for no more than 90 days.
conditions: Applies only to a Rwandan citizen holding an ordinary passport when entering the Republic of the Congo. The agreement expressly distinguishes ordinary passports from the diplomatic and service-passport exemption.

The visa is issued free at entry and is valid for a stay not exceeding 90 days. The agreement entered provisionally into force on signature on 24 November 2021, is for an indefinite period, and is currently listed in the Republic of the Congo's ratified-agreement register.

The agreement requires use of border crossings for international traffic and preserves each Party's power to refuse entry or shorten a stay for an undesirable person. Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, service, special-document, carrier and final-admission rules remain separate.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: Djibouti arrival visa
policies.summary: Rwanda DGIE's current passport-specific schedule expressly records Visa upon arrival for the ordinary Rwandan passport in Djibouti.
conditions: This records Rwanda DGIE's passport-specific ordinary column and is not a conclusion from Djibouti portal availability.
Purpose, duration, port, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: South Sudan arrival visa
policies.summary: Rwanda DGIE's current passport-specific schedule records a free visa on arrival for an ordinary Rwandan passport in South Sudan.
conditions: Rwanda DGIE uses the wording Visa free on arrival for South Sudan. This is normalized as a visa issued on arrival without a fee, not as visa-free entry.
Purpose, duration, port, documentation, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Rwandan visitor and makes its electronic tourist-visa route available online worldwide except in the United States.
conditions: Use a Rwandan ordinary passport. Cuba names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; a non-resident Rwandan visitor must obtain the tourist visa.
Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel. Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is separate; the tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, with a possible 90-day extension.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Rwandan ordinary passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service makes an online, emailed tourism visa available to citizens of all countries, subject to stated waiver exceptions and ordinary passport validity.
conditions: Use a valid Rwandan ordinary passport with at least six months' validity, photo, return ticket and listed supporting evidence. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days.

Apply online, upload documents and pay the fee. Nigeria Immigration Service says the applicant receives the visa certificate by email; this is electronic issuance, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

The source excepts ECOWAS member States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. It does not identify a Rwandan ordinary-passport exception. Work, residence, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa service
steps: Apply online using the Rwandan ordinary passport and upload the required tourism documents.
Pay the fee and await the emailed visa certificate before travel.
Use the electronic certificate subject to carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: Ukraine advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Ukraine MFA's travel-passport table requires a visa for Rwandan citizens, and its visa guidance routes required-visa applicants to Ukrainian embassies or consulates before travel.
conditions: Apply to the relevant Ukrainian embassy or consulate before travel; this is an advance consular route, not an eVisa or visa-on-arrival classification.
War-related border, air-access, occupied-territory permit, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate from this visa classification.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's live Government announcement confirms its named online-visa portal is available to all interested visitors; that portal accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the resulting eVisa electronically before travel.
conditions: Apply using the Rwandan ordinary passport that will be used for travel; the current portal excludes other travel documents and requires a passport valid at least 30 days from arrival with a blank page.
Register, upload the stated visitor documents, pay online, and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not an ETA or visa on arrival.
Purpose, duration, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea Government-announced eVisa service
steps: Register and submit the visitor eVisa application using the Rwandan ordinary passport.
Upload supporting documents and pay online.
Receive and carry the eVisa PDF issued by email before travel.
